function factFor(it,eraIdx){
 var p=POOL[it.icon];var era=NM(eraIdx);
 if(it.note)return p.n+': '+it.note;
 if(it.ok)return p.n+': '+p.f+'. It belongs in this scene.';

}

   });
   s+='</div><p class="note">'+SCENES.filter(function(q){return st.cleared.indexOf(K(q.era))>=0;}).length+' / 42 scenes cleared. 40 scenes have painted-in objects; 2 original scenes keep icons.</p>';

function tap(ix){
 if(A.over)return;
 var sc=SCENES[A.era],it=sc.items[ix];
 if(A.found[ix])return;

 else{A.found[ix]=1;A.foundCount++;A.last=factFor(it,A.era);

     var st=sv();var score=500-A.wrongs*50;
     if(!(st.best[K(A.era)]>=score))st.best[K(A.era)]=score;
     if(st.cleared.indexOf(K(A.era))<0)st.cleared.push(K(A.era));
     save(st);
     try{PAS.add('anx|'+K(A.era),'Anachronist: '+NM(A.era)+', points',score,'pts',false,score+' pts, '+A.wrongs+' mistakes');}catch(e){}
   }
 }
 window.render();
}
/* Correct only Anachronist rank direction; keep saved run rows. */
(function(){try{var k='pa.scores.timelab.v1',raw=localStorage.getItem(k);if(!raw)return;var o=JSON.parse(raw),changed=false;if(!o||typeof o!=='object'||Array.isArray(o))return;Object.keys(o).forEach(function(id){var b=o[id];if(id.indexOf('anx|')!==0||!b||!Array.isArray(b.r)||b.low!==true)return;b.low=false;b.r.sort(function(a,c){return c.s-a.s});changed=true;});if(changed)localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(o));}catch(e){}})();
XL.reg('anx',{
 open:function(){A.era=null;A.found={};A.foundCount=0;A.wrongs=0;A.over=false;A.last='';},
 close:function(){A.era=null;},
 render:render
});
XL.anx={
 stageTap:function(ev){
  if(A.over||A.era===null||(A.era===24||A.era===22))return;
  var st=document.getElementById('anxstage');if(!st)return;
  var r=st.getBoundingClientRect();
  var x=(ev.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100,y=(ev.clientY-r.top)/r.height*100;
  var sc=SCENES[A.era],best=-1,bd=1e9;
  sc.items.forEach(function(it,ix){var b=BOUNDS[A.era][ix],dx=(it.x-x)/b[0],dy=(it.y-y)/b[1],d=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(Math.abs(dx)<=1&&Math.abs(dy)<=1&&d<bd){bd=d;best=ix;}});
  if(best>=0){tap(best);}
  else{A.wrongs++;A.last='Nothing out of time there. (-50)';window.render();}
 },
 start:function(i){A.era=i;A.found={};A.foundCount=0;A.wrongs=0;A.over=false;A.last='';try{if(i<25)age=i;}catch(e){}window.render();scrollTo(0,0);},
 menu:function(){A.era=null;window.render();scrollTo(0,0);},
 tap:tap,
 next:function(){var st=sv();for(var i=0;i<PTOT;i++){if(st.cleared.indexOf(K((A.era+1+i)%PTOT))<0){XL.anx.start((A.era+1+i)%PTOT);return;}}XL.anx.menu();}
};
})();

</script>

Object.keys(G).forEach(function(name){
 var def=G[name];
 var frames=def.f.map(function(rows){
  var w=0,i;for(i=0;i<rows.length;i++)w=Math.max(w,rows[i].length);
  var cv=mkCanvas(w,rows.length),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
  for(var y=0;y<rows.length;y++)for(var x=0;x<rows[y].length;x++){
   var ch=rows[y][x];if(ch==='.'||ch===' ')continue;
   ctx.fillStyle=def.c[ch]||'#5ef2c8';ctx.fillRect(x,y,1,1);
  }
  return cv;
 });
 ART[name]={w:frames[0].width,h:frames[0].height,frames:frames};
});
window.DASHART=ART;
})();

/* Era Rush: side-scrolling run-and-jump through all 25 Time Lab periods. Original game. */
(function(){
'use strict';
/* period names/ranges come from the app's own ages table; fallbacks match it exactly */
var AGES=[
['Palaeolithic',-2600000,-9701,0],['Mesolithic transition',-9700,-8001,0],['Neolithic communities',-8000,-4001,0],
['Early cities & copper',-4000,-3301,1],['Bronze Age worlds',-3300,-1201,1],['Iron Age worlds',-1200,-501,1],
['Classical antiquity',-500,249,2],['Late antiquity',250,600,2],['Early medieval worlds',601,999,2],
['High medieval worlds',1000,1299,2],['Late medieval worlds',1300,1499,2],['Renaissance',1400,1600,3],
['Oceanic encounters & empires',1450,1700,3],['Reformation & early modern states',1500,1649,3],
['Scientific Revolution',1543,1687,3],['Enlightenment',1685,1789,3],['Atlantic revolutions',1760,1798,3],
['Napoleonic era',1799,1815,4],['Industrial transformation',1760,1900,4],['Empires & reform',1816,1913,4],
['First World War',1914,1918,4],['Interwar years',1919,1938,4],['Second World War',1939,1945.99,4],
['Cold War & decolonisation',1946,1991,5],['Contemporary world',1992,2026,5]];
function yr(y){var a=Math.abs(Math.round(y));if(a>=10000)return a.toLocaleString('en-US')+(y<0?' BCE':' CE');return a+(y<0?' BCE':' CE');}
function range(i){return yr(AGES[i][1])+' - '+yr(AGES[i][2]);}
/* themes: T0 cave, T1 mudbrick, T2 classical, T3 medieval, T4 renaissance, T5 harbour, T6 city, T7 industrial, T8 trench, T9 modern */
var THEMES={
 cave:{sky:['#1a2a5a','#0a1230'],far:'#3a4f8e',near:'#27396e',gt:'#3a6a4a',gf:'#2a4a34',ge:'#69d98c',sil:'hills',stars:true,gs:'grass'},
 mud:{sky:['#2a3a6a','#0e1638'],far:'#46598f',near:'#33477c',gt:'#a87b4f',gf:'#7a5a3f',ge:'#ffd9a0',sil:'ziggurat',stars:true,gs:'brick'},
 classic:{sky:['#22386a','#0c1434'],far:'#42548c',near:'#31426f',gt:'#c8d6f0',gf:'#8fa4c8',ge:'#e8f4ff',sil:'columns',stars:true,gs:'marble'},
 medieval:{sky:['#1c2c5a','#0a1230'],far:'#3d4f88',near:'#2c3c6c',gt:'#6f7a8e',gf:'#4c5568',ge:'#c9d6ea',sil:'towers',stars:true,gs:'cobble'},
 renais:{sky:['#243a6e','#0e1638'],far:'#44568e',near:'#324470',gt:'#c9854a',gf:'#9a6a3a',ge:'#f0c090',sil:'domes',stars:true,gs:'tile'},
 harbour:{sky:['#1e3464','#0a142f'],far:'#3f518a',near:'#2e406f',gt:'#9a6c40',gf:'#6b4a28',ge:'#e8c78a',sil:'ships',stars:true,gs:'plank'},
 city:{sky:['#1e3060','#0a1230'],far:'#404f86',near:'#2e3c68',gt:'#9a8a6a',gf:'#6a5f4a',ge:'#ffe9c9',sil:'city',stars:true,gs:'stone'},
 indust:{sky:['#2c2c44','#101024'],far:'#4a4a6e',near:'#3a3a58',gt:'#5a5a6a',gf:'#3a3a4a',ge:'#c8c8d8',sil:'factory',stars:false,gs:'steel'},
 trench:{sky:['#33334a','#12122a'],far:'#4c4c6a',near:'#3e3e56',gt:'#6a5a3f',gf:'#4a3f2a',ge:'#a89060',sil:'ruins',stars:false,gs:'duck'},
 modern:{sky:['#1a2c60','#0a1230'],far:'#3c4e88',near:'#2b3c6c',gt:'#565e70',gf:'#39404f',ge:'#ffd75e',sil:'towers2',stars:true,gs:'pave'}
};
/* per period: theme, walker, flyer, 3 artifacts, boss at 4/9/14/19/24 */
var LEVELS=[
 {t:'cave',w:'mosshog',f:'pterodak',a:['spear','oillamp','a_brush']},
 {t:'cave',w:'mosshog',f:'pterodak',a:['a_fish','spear','oillamp']},
 {t:'cave',w:'goat',f:'owl',a:['a_grain','pot','plough']},
 {t:'mud',w:'scarab',f:'wisp',a:['tablet','wheel','pot']},
 {t:'mud',w:'scarab',f:'wisp',a:['sword','amphora','a_hammer'],boss:'boss_bull',bname:'the Bronze Bull'},
 {t:'mud',w:'boar',f:'owl',a:['sword','a_hammer','lyre']},
 {t:'classic',w:'goat',f:'owl',a:['scroll','lyre','amphora']},
 {t:'classic',w:'boar',f:'owl',a:['scroll','astrolabe','oillamp']},
 {t:'medieval',w:'boar',f:'gargoyle',a:['book','quill','candle']},
 {t:'medieval',w:'boar',f:'gargoyle',a:['compass','longbow','book'],boss:'boss_knight',bname:'the Brass Knight'},
 {t:'medieval',w:'rat',f:'gargoyle',a:['clock','hourglass','press']},
 {t:'renais',w:'rat',f:'gull',a:['press','a_brush','compass']},
 {t:'harbour',w:'crab',f:'gull',a:['compass','telescope','a_map']},
 {t:'harbour',w:'rat',f:'gull',a:['press','book','quill']},
 {t:'city',w:'rat',f:'owl',a:['telescope','astrolabe','clock'],boss:'boss_orrery',bname:'the Orrery'},
 {t:'city',w:'rat',f:'gull',a:['book','quill','press']},
 {t:'city',w:'rat',f:'gargoyle',a:['press','quill','a_paper']},
 {t:'city',w:'boar',f:'gull',a:['a_map','telescope','balloon']},
 {t:'indust',w:'gearrat',f:'soot',a:['a_gear','train','bulb']},
 {t:'indust',w:'gearrat',f:'soot',a:['book','camera','watch'],boss:'boss_boiler',bname:'the Boiler Titan'},
 {t:'trench',w:'gearrat',f:'wisp',a:['plane','a_medical','watch']},
 {t:'trench',w:'gearrat',f:'gull',a:['radio','car','plane']},
 {t:'trench',w:'gearrat',f:'soot',a:['radio','plane','pen']},
 {t:'modern',w:'boombot',f:'drake',a:['tv','a_satellite','computer']},
 {t:'modern',w:'boombot',f:'drake',a:['laptop','phone','a_leaf'],boss:'boss_unraveler',bname:'the Unraveler'}
];
/* artifact display names */
var ANAMES={spear:'Spear',oillamp:'Oil lamp',a_brush:'Paint brush',a_fish:'Fish',a_grain:'Grain',pot:'Pot',plough:'Plough',
 tablet:'Clay tablet',wheel:'Wheel',sword:'Sword',amphora:'Amphora',a_hammer:'Hammer',lyre:'Lyre',scroll:'Scroll',
 astrolabe:'Astrolabe',book:'Book',quill:'Quill',candle:'Candle',compass:'Compass',hourglass:'Hourglass',press:'Printing press',
 clock:'Clock',telescope:'Telescope',a_map:'Sea chart',balloon:'Balloon',a_gear:'Gear',train:'Locomotive',bulb:'Light bulb',
 camera:'Camera',watch:'Wristwatch',plane:'Aeroplane',a_medical:'Medical kit',radio:'Radio',car:'Motor car',pen:'Ballpoint pen',
 tv:'Television',a_satellite:'Satellite',computer:'Computer',laptop:'Laptop',phone:'Smartphone',a_leaf:'Leaf',a_paper:'Pamphlet',longbow:'Longbow'};
var PROP={cave:'spear',mud:'tablet',classic:'scroll',medieval:'sword',renais:'quill',harbour:'compass',city:'book',indust:'a_gear',trench:'train',modern:'a_satellite'};
/* ---------- seeded RNG ---------- */
function RNG(seed){var s=seed>>>0||1;return function(){s=(s*1664525+1013904223)>>>0;return s/4294967296;};}
var R=RNG;
/* ---------- level generator ----------
   tiles: 15 rows x W cols. 0 empty, 1 solid ground, 2 platform block, 3 spikes, 4 gate marker col */
var ROWS=15, TILE=16;
function genLevel(idx){
 var L=LEVELS[idx], rnd=R((idx+1)*7919), W=180+Math.floor(rnd()*30), tiles=[],x,y;
 for(y=0;y<ROWS;y++){tiles.push(new Array(W).fill(0));}
 var g=ROWS-3; /* ground top row */
 var spawns=[],berries=[],capsules=[],arts=[],checks=[];
 /* start flat */
 for(x=0;x<14;x++)for(y=g;y<ROWS;y++)tiles[y][x]=1;
 x=14;
 var groundTop=g,lastGap=false;
 while(x<W-24){
  var r=rnd();
  if(lastGap)r=0.5; /* never two gaps in a row: pits stay jumpable */
  lastGap=false;
  if(r<0.16){ /* gap 2-4 */
   lastGap=true;
   var gw=2+Math.floor(rnd()*3);
   for(var i=0;i<gw&&x<W-24;i++,x++); /* leave empty */
   /* berry arc over the gap */
   for(var b=0;b<gw;b++)berries.push({x:(x-gw+b)*TILE+8,y:(groundTop-3-Math.abs(b-(gw-1)/2))*TILE});
  }else if(r<0.34){ /* step pyramid up/down 1-2 */
   var hgt=1+Math.floor(rnd()*2),dir=rnd()<0.5?-1:1;
   var newTop=Math.min(ROWS-3,Math.max(ROWS-8,groundTop+dir*hgt));
   var steps=Math.abs(newTop-groundTop)||1;
   for(var s=0;s<steps*2+2&&x<W-24;s++,x++){
    var top=groundTop+Math.sign(newTop-groundTop)*Math.min(steps,Math.floor(s/2)+ (s>=steps*2?steps:0));
    if(s>=steps*2)top=newTop;
    for(y=Math.min(top,groundTop);y<ROWS;y++)if(tiles[y][x]!==3)tiles[y][x]=1;
   }
   groundTop=newTop;
  }else if(r<0.52){ /* floating platform with berries (ground stays: reachable jumps only) */
   var pl=3+Math.floor(rnd()*3),pr=groundTop-3;
   if(pr>3){for(var p=0;p<pl&&x<W-24;p++,x++){tiles[pr][x]=2;for(y=groundTop;y<ROWS;y++)if(tiles[y][x]!==3)tiles[y][x]=1;berries.push({x:x*TILE+8,y:(pr-1.5)*TILE});}}
   else{x+=2;}
  }else if(r<0.62){ /* spike patch 1-2 */
   var sw=1+Math.floor(rnd()*2);
   for(var q=0;q<sw&&x<W-24;q++,x++){for(y=groundTop;y<ROWS;y++)if(tiles[y][x]!==3)tiles[y][x]=1;if(tiles[groundTop-1][x]===0)tiles[groundTop-1][x]=3;}
  }else{ /* plain stretch with occasional berry line */
   var len=4+Math.floor(rnd()*5);
   for(var m=0;m<len&&x<W-24;m++,x++){
    for(y=groundTop;y<ROWS;y++)if(tiles[y][x]!==3)tiles[y][x]=1;
    if(rnd()<0.4)berries.push({x:x*TILE+8,y:(groundTop-1.6)*TILE});
   }
  }
  /* enemies */
  if(rnd()<0.5&&x<W-30)spawns.push({kind:'w',x:x*TILE+8,y:(groundTop-2)*TILE});
  if(rnd()<0.28&&x<W-30)spawns.push({kind:'f',x:x*TILE+8,y:(groundTop-6-Math.floor(rnd()*2))*TILE});
 }
 /* end stretch flat */
 for(;x<W;x++)for(y=groundTop;y<ROWS;y++)tiles[y][x]=1;
 /* checkpoints at 45% */
 checks.push(Math.floor(W*0.45)*TILE);
 /* capsules: bolt early, board mid, sprite late - grounded at their actual column */
 function capY(px){var c=Math.floor(px/TILE);for(var r2=1;r2<ROWS;r2++)if(tiles[r2][c]===1||tiles[r2][c]===2)return (r2-2)*TILE+8;return (ROWS-5)*TILE+8;}
 capsules.push({x:Math.floor(W*0.05)*TILE,y:capY(Math.floor(W*0.05)*TILE),gives:'bolt'});
 capsules.push({x:Math.floor(W*0.5)*TILE,y:capY(Math.floor(W*0.5)*TILE),gives:'board'});
 capsules.push({x:Math.floor(W*0.75)*TILE,y:capY(Math.floor(W*0.75)*TILE),gives:'sprite'});
 /* 3 artifacts: early platform-ish, mid, late */
 arts.push({x:Math.floor(W*0.25)*TILE,y:capY(Math.floor(W*0.25)*TILE),k:L.a[0],got:false});
 arts.push({x:Math.floor(W*0.58)*TILE,y:capY(Math.floor(W*0.58)*TILE),k:L.a[1],got:false});
 arts.push({x:Math.floor(W*0.85)*TILE,y:capY(Math.floor(W*0.85)*TILE),k:L.a[2],got:false});
 var gate={x:(W-6)*TILE,y:(groundTop-4)*TILE};
 var boss=null;
 if(L.boss)boss={x:(W-16)*TILE,y:(groundTop-4)*TILE,hp:10,kind:L.boss,t:0,vx:0,vy:0,dir:-1,hop:0,arena:Math.floor(W*0.8)*TILE};
 /* spike sanity: fill below, drop spikes embedded flush with the floor */
 for(var sy=0;sy<ROWS-1;sy++)for(var sx=0;sx<W;sx++){
  if(tiles[sy][sx]!==3)continue;
  tiles[sy+1][sx]=1;
  var l=sx>0?tiles[sy][sx-1]:0,rr=sx<W-1?tiles[sy][sx+1]:0;
  if((l===1||l===3)&&(rr===1||rr===3)&&(sy+1>=groundTop? true:true) && (l===1&&rr===1))tiles[sy][sx]=1;
 }
 /* spike/headroom guard: no platforms in the jump arc above a spike's approach */
 for(var sy2=1;sy2<ROWS;sy2++)for(var sx2=0;sx2<W;sx2++){
  if(tiles[sy2][sx2]!==3)continue;
  for(var pc=Math.max(0,sx2-4);pc<=Math.min(W-1,sx2+1);pc++)
   for(var pr2=Math.max(0,sy2-2);pr2<sy2;pr2++)
    if(tiles[pr2][pc]===2)tiles[pr2][pc]=0;
 }
 /* pit jump-arc guard: no floating platforms ceiling the takeoff run-up or same-level landing of a pit */
 function surfRowAt(c){var fb=0;for(var r2=1;r2<ROWS;r2++){if(tiles[r2][c]===1)return r2;if(!fb&&tiles[r2][c]===2)fb=r2;}return fb||ROWS-3;}
 for(var p0=1;p0<W-1;p0++){
  var pitHere=true;
  for(var gr=6;gr<ROWS;gr++)if(tiles[gr][p0]!==0){pitHere=false;break;}
  if(!pitHere)continue;
  var p1=p0;
  while(p1+1<W-1){var np=true;for(var gr2=6;gr2<ROWS;gr2++)if(tiles[gr2][p1+1]!==0){np=false;break;}if(!np)break;p1++;}
  var t0=surfRowAt(p0-1),t1=surfRowAt(p1+1);
  for(var tc=Math.max(1,p0-4);tc<=p0-1;tc++)for(var tr=Math.max(1,t0-4);tr<=t0-2;tr++)if(tiles[tr][tc]===2)tiles[tr][tc]=0;
  if(t1>=t0)for(var lc=p1+1;lc<=Math.min(W-1,p1+2);lc++)for(var lr=Math.max(1,t1-4);lr<=t1-2;lr++)if(tiles[lr][lc]===2)tiles[lr][lc]=0;
  p0=p1;
 }
 return {tiles:tiles,W:W,groundTop:groundTop,spawns:spawns,berries:berries,capsules:capsules,arts:arts,checks:checks,gate:gate,boss:boss,start:{x:2*TILE,y:(groundTop-4)*TILE},gt:groundTop};
}
/* ---------- parallax background builder ---------- */
function makeBG(theme,W){
 var cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=320;cv.height=240;
 var c=cv.getContext('2d');
 var grad=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,240);grad.addColorStop(0,theme.sky[0]);grad.addColorStop(1,theme.sky[1]);
 c.fillStyle=grad;c.fillRect(0,0,320,240);
 if(theme.stars){c.fillStyle='rgba(232,244,255,.7)';var r=R(99);for(var i=0;i<40;i++){c.fillRect(Math.floor(r()*320),Math.floor(r()*110),1,1);}
 for(var i2=0;i2<14;i2++){var sx2=Math.floor(r()*320),sy3=Math.floor(r()*120);c.fillStyle='rgba(232,244,255,.16)';c.fillRect(sx2-1,sy3-1,4,4);c.fillStyle='rgba(232,244,255,.9)';c.fillRect(sx2,sy3,2,2);}}
 var aur=c.createLinearGradient(0,60,0,150);aur.addColorStop(0,'rgba(94,242,200,0)');aur.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(94,242,200,.06)');aur.addColorStop(1,'rgba(94,242,200,0)');c.fillStyle=aur;c.fillRect(0,60,320,90);
 c.fillStyle='rgba(255,224,102,.25)';c.beginPath();c.arc(268,36,13,0,7);c.fill();
 c.fillStyle='#ffe066';c.beginPath();c.arc(268,36,10,0,7);c.fill();c.fillStyle=theme.sky[0];c.beginPath();c.arc(272,32,9,0,7);c.fill();
 return cv;
}
function makeLayer(theme,near){
 /* 640x240 silhouette strip, drawn twice side by side for wrap */
 var cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=640;cv.height=240;
 var c=cv.getContext('2d');c.fillStyle=near?theme.near:theme.far;
 var r=R(near?7:3),base=near?200:170,x,y,h,w;
 switch(theme.sil){
  case 'hills':
   c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,240);
   for(x=0;x<=640;x+=32){c.lineTo(x,base-Math.abs(Math.sin(x*0.02+(near?2:0)))*(near?56:36)-r()*6);}
   c.lineTo(640,240);c.fill();
   if(near){for(x=30;x<640;x+=50+Math.floor(r()*60)){var tpy=base-Math.abs(Math.sin(x*0.02+2))*56+2;
    c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x-7,tpy-4);c.lineTo(x,tpy-18);c.lineTo(x+7,tpy-4);c.fill();
    c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x-5,tpy-12);c.lineTo(x,tpy-24);c.lineTo(x+5,tpy-12);c.fill();
    c.fillRect(x-1,tpy-4,2,6);}}
   else{var vpy=base-Math.abs(Math.sin(320*0.02))*36;
    c.beginPath();c.moveTo(280,vpy);c.lineTo(312,vpy-34);c.lineTo(328,vpy-34);c.lineTo(360,vpy);c.fill();
    c.fillStyle='rgba(255,90,60,.5)';c.fillRect(312,vpy-37,16,5);
    c.fillStyle='rgba(255,150,60,.3)';c.fillRect(316,vpy-46,8,9);}
   break;
  case 'ziggurat':
   for(x=0;x<640;x+=(near?170:130)+Math.floor(r()*90)){
    var w=44+Math.floor(r()*36),hh=(near?30:20)+Math.floor(r()*10);
    for(var tt=0;tt<3;tt++){var tw=w*(1-tt*0.28),thh=hh/3;c.fillRect(x+(w-tw)/2,base-hh+tt*thh,tw,thh+1);}
    c.fillRect(x+w/2-3,base-hh-8,6,8);
   }
   c.fillRect(0,base,640,240-base);break;
  case 'columns': case 'domes': case 'towers': case 'towers2':
   for(x=0;x<640;x+=40+Math.floor(r()*30)){w=20+Math.floor(r()*26);h=30+Math.floor(r()*(near?80:50));
    c.fillRect(x,base-h,w,h);
    if(theme.sil==='domes'){c.beginPath();c.arc(x+w/2,base-h,w/2,Math.PI,0);c.fill();}
    if(theme.sil==='columns'&&r()<0.4){c.fillRect(x-4,base-h-8,w+8,6);}
    if(theme.sil==='towers'||theme.sil==='towers2'){c.fillRect(x+w/2-3,base-h-14,6,14);}
    if(near&&(theme.sil==='towers2'||theme.sil==='city')){c.fillStyle='rgba(255,224,102,.8)';for(var wy=base-h+6;wy<base-8;wy+=10)for(var wx=x+3;wx<x+w-4;wx+=8)if(r()<0.4)c.fillRect(wx,wy,3,4);c.fillStyle=theme.near;}
   }
   c.fillRect(0,base,640,240-base);break;
  case 'ships':
   for(x=0;x<640;x+=110+Math.floor(r()*60)){
    c.fillRect(x,base-14,70,14);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x-10,base);c.lineTo(x+80,base);c.lineTo(x+66,base+14);c.lineTo(x+4,base+14);c.fill();
    c.fillRect(x+30,base-64,4,50);c.fillRect(x+10,base-58,44,4);c.fillRect(x+14,base-42,36,4);
   }
   c.fillRect(0,base+14,640,240-base-14);break;
  case 'factory':
   for(x=0;x<640;x+=60+Math.floor(r()*40)){w=34+Math.floor(r()*20);h=34+Math.floor(r()*(near?60:36));
    c.fillRect(x,base-h,w,h);c.fillRect(x+4,base-h-24,8,24);c.fillRect(x+16,base-h-18,8,18);c.fillStyle='rgba(200,200,220,.22)';c.fillRect(x+2,base-h-34,10,8);c.fillRect(x+9,base-h-45,13,9);c.fillStyle=near?theme.near:theme.far;}
   c.fillRect(0,base,640,240-base);break;
  case 'ruins':
   for(x=0;x<640;x+=36+Math.floor(r()*40)){w=16+Math.floor(r()*24);h=12+Math.floor(r()*(near?40:26));
    c.fillRect(x,base-h,w,h);if(r()<0.5)c.fillRect(x+w-6,base-h-10,6,10);}
   c.fillRect(0,base,640,240-base);break;
  case 'city':
   for(x=0;x<640;x+=44+Math.floor(r()*26)){w=26+Math.floor(r()*22);h=40+Math.floor(r()*(near?90:56));c.fillRect(x,base-h,w,h);}
   c.fillRect(0,base,640,240-base);break;
 }
 c.globalCompositeOperation='source-atop';
 var lg=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,240);lg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(232,244,255,.14)');lg.addColorStop(.75,'rgba(232,244,255,.03)');lg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.18)');
 c.fillStyle=lg;c.fillRect(0,0,640,240);
 c.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
 return cv;
}

 bolts:[],parts:[],t:0,shake:0,paused:false,auto:false,respawnX:0,gateOpen:false,artGot:0,raf:0,last:0,acc:0,
 stats:null,cpIndex:0};
function sv(){var s=XL.store('xl-dash');if(!s)s={best:0,unlocked:0,stars:[],cleared:[],muted:false};return s;}
function save(s){XL.store('xl-dash',s);}
/* ---------- run autosave / resume ---------- */
function saveRun(){
 if(D.mode!=='play'||!D.lv||!D.hero)return;
 var s=sv();
 s.run={startIdx:D.runStart||0,idx:D.idx,x:Math.round(D.hero.x),y:Math.round(D.hero.y),face:D.hero.face,
  score:D.score,lives:D.lives,charge:Math.round(D.charge),artGot:D.artGot,
  hasBolt:D.hasBolt,board:D.board,shieldT:D.shieldT,gateOpen:D.gateOpen,
  respawnX:D.respawnX,cpIndex:D.cpIndex,cam:Math.round(D.cam),camY:Math.round(D.camY||0),
  berries:D.lv.berries.map(function(b){return b.got?1:0;}),
  caps:D.lv.capsules.map(function(cp){return cp.open?1:0;}),
  arts:D.lv.arts.map(function(a){return a.got?1:0;}),
  enemies:D.enemies.map(function(e){return e.dead?1:0;}),
  boss:D.lv.boss?{hp:D.lv.boss.hp,dead:!!D.lv.boss.dead,x:D.lv.boss.x,y:D.lv.boss.y,dir:D.lv.boss.dir}:null,
  when:Date.now()};
 save(s);
}
function recordRun(reason){if(D.recorded)return;D.recorded=true;var s=sv();if(D.score>s.best)s.best=D.score;save(s);try{PAS.add('dash|run','Era Rush, run points',D.score,'pts',false,'Started period '+((D.runStart||0)+1)+'; ended period '+(D.idx+1)+'; '+reason)}catch(e){}}
function clearRun(){var s=sv();if(s.run){delete s.run;save(s);}}
function restoreRun(){
 var s=sv();if(!s.run)return false;
 try{
  var r=s.run;
  if(typeof r.idx!=='number'||r.idx<0||r.idx>24){clearRun();return false;}
  startLevel(r.idx);
  var lv=D.lv;
  (r.berries||[]).forEach(function(g,i){if(lv.berries[i])lv.berries[i].got=!!g;});
  (r.caps||[]).forEach(function(g,i){if(lv.capsules[i])lv.capsules[i].open=!!g;});
  (r.arts||[]).forEach(function(g,i){if(lv.arts[i])lv.arts[i].got=!!g;});
  (r.enemies||[]).forEach(function(g,i){if(g&&D.enemies[i])D.enemies[i].dead=true;});
  if(lv.boss&&r.boss){lv.boss.hp=r.boss.hp;lv.boss.dead=!!r.boss.dead;lv.boss.x=r.boss.x;lv.boss.y=r.boss.y;lv.boss.dir=r.boss.dir;}
  D.hero.x=r.x;D.hero.y=r.y;D.hero.face=r.face||1;D.hero.iframes=30;
  D.score=r.score|0;D.lives=r.lives|0;D.charge=Math.max(20,r.charge|0);D.artGot=r.artGot|0;
  D.hasBolt=!!r.hasBolt;D.board=!!r.board;D.shieldT=r.shieldT|0;D.gateOpen=!!r.gateOpen;
  D.respawnX=r.respawnX|0;D.cpIndex=r.cpIndex|0;D.cam=r.cam|0;D.camY=r.camY|0;
  D.runStart=r.startIdx||0;D.recorded=false;D.carry=true;D.mode='play';render();return true;
 }catch(e){clearRun();return false;}
}
/* ---------- sound ---------- */
var AC=null;
function beep(f,d,type,v,slide){
 var s=sv();if(s.muted)return;
 try{
  if(!AC)AC=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
  var o=AC.createOscillator(),g=AC.createGain();
  o.type=type||'square';o.frequency.value=f;
  if(slide)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40,f+slide),AC.currentTime+d);
  g.gain.value=v||0.05;g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,AC.currentTime+d);
  o.connect(g);g.connect(AC.destination);o.start();o.stop(AC.currentTime+d);
 }catch(e){}
}
var SFX={
 jump:function(){beep(280,0.16,'square',0.04,300);},
 berry:function(){beep(660,0.09,'square',0.05,220);},
 bolt:function(){beep(880,0.08,'sawtooth',0.03,-400);},
 hitE:function(){beep(200,0.12,'square',0.06,-120);},
 die:function(){beep(320,0.5,'sawtooth',0.06,-260);},
 capsule:function(){beep(520,0.18,'triangle',0.06,260);},
 artifact:function(){beep(740,0.22,'triangle',0.06,240);},
 boss:function(){beep(140,0.2,'sawtooth',0.07,-60);},
 gate:function(){beep(440,0.4,'triangle',0.06,440);},
 board:function(){beep(360,0.2,'square',0.05,180);}
};
/* ---------- input ---------- */
var IN={left:false,right:false,jump:false,throwB:false,jumpHeld:false};
function bindInput(){
 window.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(D.mode!=='play')return;
  var tg=e.target,tn=tg&&tg.tagName;if(tn==='INPUT'||tn==='TEXTAREA'||tn==='SELECT'||(tg&&tg.isContentEditable))return;
  if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='a')IN.left=true;
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='d')IN.right=true;
  if(e.key==='ArrowUp'||e.key==='w'||e.key==='z'){IN.jump=true;IN.jumpHeld=true;e.preventDefault();}
  if(e.key===' '||e.code==='Space'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat&&!D.paused)IN.throwB=true;}
  if(e.key==='x'||e.key==='k')IN.throwB=true;
 });
 window.addEventListener('keyup',function(e){
  if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='a')IN.left=false;
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='d')IN.right=false;
  if(e.key==='ArrowUp'||e.key==='w'||e.key==='z')IN.jumpHeld=false;
 });
}
bindInput();
window.addEventListener('pagehide',function(){if(D.mode==='play')saveRun();});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){if(document.hidden&&D.mode==='play')saveRun();});
var XL_close0=XL.close;XL.close=function(){if(D.mode==='play')saveRun();XL_close0();};
function padBtn(id,prop){
 var el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;
 var on=function(e){e.preventDefault();IN[prop]=true;if(prop==='jump')IN.jumpHeld=true;el.classList.add('on');};
 var off=function(e){e.preventDefault();IN[prop]=false;if(prop==='jump')IN.jumpHeld=false;el.classList.remove('on');};
 el.addEventListener('pointerdown',on);
 el.addEventListener('pointerup',off);
 el.addEventListener('pointercancel',off);
 el.addEventListener('pointerleave',off);
 el.addEventListener('contextmenu',function(e){e.preventDefault();});
}
var dragId=null,dragX=0;
function bindDrag(){
 var cv=document.getElementById('dashcv');if(!cv)return;
 cv.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
  if(D.mode!=='play'||dragId!==null)return;
  dragId=e.pointerId;dragX=e.clientX;
  try{cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(_){}
  e.preventDefault();
 });
 cv.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
  if(e.pointerId!==dragId)return;
  var dx=e.clientX-dragX;
  IN.right=dx>12;IN.left=dx<-12;
  e.preventDefault();
 });
 var dragEnd=function(e){
  if(e.pointerId!==dragId)return;
  dragId=null;IN.left=false;IN.right=false;
 };
 cv.addEventListener('pointerup',dragEnd);
 cv.addEventListener('pointercancel',dragEnd);
 cv.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',dragEnd);
 cv.addEventListener('contextmenu',function(e){e.preventDefault();});
}
/* ---------- physics helpers ---------- */
function solidAt(lv,col,row){
 if(col<0||col>=lv.W)return true;
 if(row<0||row>=ROWS)return false;
 var t=lv.tiles[row][col];return t===1||t===2||t===3;
}
function hazardAt(lv,col,row){
 if(col<0||col>=lv.W||row<0||row>=ROWS)return false;
 return lv.tiles[row][col]===3;
}
function moveBox(lv,e,w,h){
 /* x axis */
 e.x+=e.vx;
 var top=Math.floor(e.y/TILE),bot=Math.floor((e.y+h-1)/TILE),col;
 if(e.vx>0){col=Math.floor((e.x+w)/TILE);
  for(var r=top;r<=bot;r++)if(solidAt(lv,col,r)){e.x=col*TILE-w-0.01;e.vx=0;e.hitWall=true;break;}
 }else if(e.vx<0){col=Math.floor(e.x/TILE);
  for(var r2=top;r2<=bot;r2++)if(solidAt(lv,col,r2)){e.x=(col+1)*TILE+0.01;e.vx=0;e.hitWall=true;break;}
 }
 /* y axis */
 e.y+=e.vy;e.onGround=false;
 var lft=Math.floor((e.x+1)/TILE),rgt=Math.floor((e.x+w-1)/TILE),row;
 if(e.vy>0){row=Math.floor((e.y+h)/TILE);
  for(var c=lft;c<=rgt;c++)if(solidAt(lv,c,row)){e.y=row*TILE-h-0.01;e.vy=0;e.onGround=true;break;}
 }else if(e.vy<0){row=Math.floor(e.y/TILE);
  for(var c2=lft;c2<=rgt;c2++)if(solidAt(lv,c2,row)){e.y=(row+1)*TILE+0.01;e.vy=0;break;}
 }
}
function overlap(a,b,aw,ah,bw,bh){return a.x<b.x+bw&&a.x+aw>b.x&&a.y<b.y+bh&&a.y+ah>b.y;}
/* ---------- level lifecycle ---------- */
function startLevel(idx){
 D.idx=idx;D.lv=genLevel(idx);D.t=0;D.cam=0;D.bolts=[];D.parts=[];D.shieldT=0;D.board=false;D.hasBolt=false;
 D.charge=100;D.artGot=0;D.gateOpen=false;D.shake=0;D.cpIndex=0;D.camY=Math.max(0,Math.min(ROWS*TILE-120,(D.lv.start?D.lv.start.y:96)+9-72));
 D.hero={x:D.lv.start.x,y:D.lv.start.y,vx:0,vy:0,face:1,onGround:false,iframes:0,animT:0,throwT:0,coyote:0,buffer:0};
 IN.left=IN.right=IN.jump=IN.throwB=IN.jumpHeld=false;dragId=null;
 D.respawnX=D.lv.start.x;
 D.enemies=D.lv.spawns.map(function(s){return {kind:s.kind,x:s.x,y:s.y,vx:s.kind==='w'?-0.6:0,vy:0,t:Math.random()*6.28,baseY:s.y,dead:false,iframes:0};});
 if(D.lv.boss)D.lv.boss.flash=0;
}
function respawn(cause){
 D.deaths=D.deaths||[];if(cause&&D.hero)D.deaths.push({c:cause,x:Math.round(D.hero.x),y:Math.round(D.hero.y)});
 D.lives--;
 if(D.stats)D.stats.deaths=(D.stats.deaths||0)+1;
 if(D.lives<0){recordRun('out of time');clearRun();D.mode='gameover';render();return;}
 var lv=D.lv,col=Math.floor(D.respawnX/TILE),gy=0;
 while(gy<ROWS&&!solidAt(lv,col,gy))gy++;
 D.hero={x:D.respawnX,y:(gy-3)*TILE,vx:0,vy:0,face:1,onGround:false,iframes:90,animT:0,throwT:0,coyote:0,buffer:0};
 D.charge=Math.max(D.charge,55);D.board=false;D.shieldT=0;D.bolts=[];
}
function heroHit(){
 var h=D.hero;
 if(h.iframes>0||D.shieldT>0)return;
 if(D.board){D.board=false;h.iframes=90;D.shake=8;SFX.hitE();spawnParts(h.x,h.y,'#5aa0ff',10);return;}
 SFX.die();spawnParts(h.x,h.y,'#ff5a5e',16);
 respawn(D._hitBy||'hit');
}
function spawnParts(x,y,color,n){
 for(var i=0;i<n;i++)D.parts.push({x:x,y:y,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*4,vy:-Math.random()*3-1,life:30+Math.random()*20,c:color});
}
/* ---------- autopilot (testing) ---------- */
function autoInput(){
 var lv=D.lv,h=D.hero;
 IN.right=true;IN.left=false;IN.jump=false;IN.throwB=false;
 var footRow=Math.floor((h.y+20)/TILE),ahead=Math.floor((h.x+18)/TILE);
 var gapNear=false;
 for(var ga=0;ga<3;ga++){var ac=ahead+ga;if(!solidAt(lv,ac,footRow)&&!solidAt(lv,ac,footRow+1)&&!solidAt(lv,ac,footRow+2)&&!solidAt(lv,ac,footRow+3)){gapNear=true;break;}}
 var gapAhead=gapNear;
 var wallAhead=solidAt(lv,Math.floor((h.x+13)/TILE),Math.floor((h.y+10)/TILE));
 var spikeAhead=hazardAt(lv,ahead,footRow)||hazardAt(lv,ahead,footRow-1);
 var en=nearestEnemy();
 var enClose=en&&en.kind==='w'&&en.x>h.x&&en.x-h.x<30&&Math.abs(en.y-h.y)<26;
 if((gapAhead||wallAhead||spikeAhead||enClose)&&h.onGround){IN.jump=true;IN.jumpHeld=true;}else if(h.onGround)IN.jumpHeld=false;
 if(en&&en.x>h.x&&en.x-h.x<90&&Math.abs(en.y-h.y)<50&&D.hasBolt&&h.throwT<=0)IN.throwB=true;
 if(D.lv.boss&&!D.lv.boss.dead&&D.hasBolt&&h.throwT<=0&&Math.abs(D.lv.boss.x-h.x)<160)IN.throwB=true;
}
function nearestEnemy(){
 var h=D.hero,best=null,bd=1e9;
 (D.enemies||[]).forEach(function(e){if(e.dead)return;var d=Math.abs(e.x-h.x)+Math.abs(e.y-h.y);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=e;}});
 return best;
}
/* ---------- update ---------- */
function update(){
 if(D.paused||D.mode!=='play')return;
 D.t++;
 var lv=D.lv,h=D.hero;
 if(D.auto)autoInput();
 /* charge drain */
 D.charge-=100/(75*60);
 if(D.charge<=0){D.charge=0;SFX.die();respawn('charge');return;}
 /* hero horizontal */
 var maxS=D.board?3.4:2.3,acc=0.3;
 if(IN.right){h.vx=Math.min(maxS,h.vx+acc);h.face=1;}
 else if(IN.left){h.vx=Math.max(-maxS,h.vx-acc);h.face=-1;}
 else h.vx*=D.board?0.98:0.7;
 /* jump with coyote+buffer */
 if(h.onGround)h.coyote=7;else h.coyote--;
 if(IN.jump)h.buffer=7;else h.buffer--;
 IN.jump=false;
 if(h.buffer>0&&h.coyote>0){h.vy=-6.8;h.coyote=0;h.buffer=0;SFX.jump();}
 if(!IN.jumpHeld&&h.vy<-2.5)h.vy=-2.5;
 h.vy=Math.min(7,h.vy+0.35);
 h.hitWall=false;
 moveBox(lv,h,10,18);
 /* camera vertical follow */
 var ty=Math.max(0,Math.min(ROWS*TILE-120,h.y+9-72));
 D.camY=D.camY===undefined?ty:D.camY+(ty-D.camY)*0.18;
 if(h.iframes>0)h.iframes--;
 if(h.throwT>0)h.throwT--;
 h.animT+=Math.abs(h.vx)>0.2?Math.abs(h.vx):0;
 /* fell in a pit */
 if(h.y>ROWS*TILE+40){SFX.die();respawn('pit');return;}
 /* spikes */
 var col1=Math.floor((h.x+2)/TILE),col2=Math.floor((h.x+8)/TILE),row1=Math.floor((h.y+4)/TILE),row2=Math.floor((h.y+18)/TILE);
 for(var cc=col1;cc<=col2;cc++)for(var rr=row1;rr<=row2;rr++)if(hazardAt(lv,cc,rr)){D._hitBy='spike';heroHit();break;}
 /* throw */
 if(IN.throwB){IN.throwB=false;
  if(D.hasBolt&&h.throwT<=0){h.throwT=16;D.bolts.push({x:h.x+5,y:h.y+8,vx:4*h.face,vy:-2.4});SFX.bolt();}
 }
 /* bolts */
 for(var b=D.bolts.length-1;b>=0;b--){
  var bo=D.bolts[b];bo.vy+=0.25;bo.x+=bo.vx;bo.y+=bo.vy;
  var bc=Math.floor(bo.x/TILE),br=Math.floor(bo.y/TILE);
  if(solidAt(lv,bc,br)||bo.y>ROWS*TILE){spawnParts(bo.x,bo.y,'#5ef2c8',4);D.bolts.splice(b,1);continue;}
 }
 /* enemies */
 D.enemies.forEach(function(e){
  if(e.dead)return;
  e.t+=0.05;
  if(e.kind==='w'){
   e.vy=Math.min(6,e.vy+0.35);
   e.hitWall=false;
   var dir=e.vx>=0?1:-1;
   moveBox(lv,e,14,14);
   if(e.hitWall)e.vx=-e.vx||-0.6*dir;
   /* turn at ledges */
   if(e.onGround){
    var ac=Math.floor((e.x+(e.vx>=0?16:-2))/TILE),fr=Math.floor((e.y+16)/TILE);
    if(!solidAt(lv,ac,fr)&&!solidAt(lv,ac,fr+1))e.vx=-(e.vx||dir*0.6);
    if(e.vx===0)e.vx=-dir*0.6;
   }
  }else{
   if(e.baseX===undefined)e.baseX=e.x;
   e.vx=Math.cos(e.t*0.7)*1.1;
   e.x=e.baseX+Math.sin(e.t*0.7)*40;
   e.y=e.baseY+Math.sin(e.t*1.3)*20;
  }
  /* bolt hits */
  for(var b2=D.bolts.length-1;b2>=0;b2--){
   if(overlap(D.bolts[b2],e,6,6,14,14)){
    e.dead=true;D.score+=100;SFX.hitE();spawnParts(e.x+7,e.y+7,'#ffe066',8);
    D.bolts.splice(b2,1);break;
   }
  }
  if(!e.dead&&overlap(h,e,10,18,14,14)){
   if(D.shieldT>0){e.dead=true;D.score+=100;spawnParts(e.x+7,e.y+7,'#5ef2c8',8);}
   else{D._hitBy=e.kind;heroHit();}
  }
 });
 /* berries */
 lv.berries.forEach(function(by){
  if(by.got)return;
  if(overlap(h,by,10,18,10,10)){by.got=true;D.charge=Math.min(100,D.charge+12);D.score+=by.cake?100:50;SFX.berry();}
 });
 /* capsules */
 lv.capsules.forEach(function(cp){
  if(cp.open)return;
  var touched=overlap(h,cp,10,18,14,14);
  if(!touched)for(var b3=D.bolts.length-1;b3>=0;b3--)if(overlap(D.bolts[b3],cp,6,6,14,14)){touched=true;D.bolts.splice(b3,1);break;}
  if(touched){
   cp.open=true;D.score+=200;SFX.capsule();spawnParts(cp.x+7,cp.y+7,'#8fa4c8',8);
   if(cp.gives==='bolt')D.hasBolt=true;
   else if(cp.gives==='board'){D.board=true;SFX.board();}
   else D.shieldT=60*8;
  }
 });
 /* artifacts */
 lv.arts.forEach(function(a){
  if(a.got)return;
  if(overlap(h,a,10,18,14,14)){a.got=true;D.artGot++;D.score+=500;SFX.artifact();spawnParts(a.x+7,a.y+7,'#ffe066',10);}
 });
 /* checkpoints */
 lv.checks.forEach(function(cx){if(h.x>cx&&D.respawnX<cx)D.respawnX=cx;});
 /* shield timer */
 if(D.shieldT>0)D.shieldT--;
 /* boss */
 var bs=lv.boss;
 if(bs&&!bs.dead){
  bs.t++;
  if(bs.flash>0)bs.flash--;
  var bx=bs.x,bw=30;
  if(bs.kind==='boss_bull'){
   if(bs.cd>0){bs.cd--;bs.vx=0;}
   else if(bs.charge>0){bs.charge--;bs.vx=bs.dir*4;if(bs.charge<=0)bs.cd=90;}
   else{bs.dir=h.x>bs.x?1:-1;bs.charge=50;}
   bs.vy=Math.min(6,bs.vy+0.35);bs.hitWall=false;moveBox(lv,bs,30,30);
  }else if(bs.kind==='boss_knight'){
   bs.vx=(h.x>bs.x?1:-1)*1.0;
   if(bs.onGround&&Math.abs(h.x-bs.x)<60&&Math.random()<0.02)bs.vy=-6.5;
   bs.vy=Math.min(6,bs.vy+0.35);bs.hitWall=false;moveBox(lv,bs,26,32);
  }else if(bs.kind==='boss_orrery'){
   bs.x+= (h.x-bs.x)*0.008;
   bs.y= (lv.gt-8)*TILE+Math.sin(bs.t*0.04)*40;
   if(bs.t%140===0){bs.dive=40;}
   if(bs.dive>0){bs.dive--;bs.y+=3;}
  }else if(bs.kind==='boss_boiler'){
   bs.vx=(h.x>bs.x?1:-1)*0.5;
   if(bs.onGround&&bs.t%110===0){bs.vy=-7.5;D.shake=6;}
   bs.vy=Math.min(7,bs.vy+0.35);bs.hitWall=false;moveBox(lv,bs,30,30);
  }else{ /* unraveler */
   if(bs.t%150===0){bs.x=h.x+120*(Math.random()<0.5?-1:1);bs.x=Math.max(bs.arena,Math.min(lv.W*TILE-80,bs.x));spawnParts(bs.x,bs.y,'#8a6ae8',12);}
   bs.x+=(h.x-bs.x)*0.006;
   bs.y=(lv.gt-5)*TILE+Math.sin(bs.t*0.06)*30;
  }
  /* clamp boss to arena */
  if(bs.x<bs.arena)bs.x=bs.arena;
  if(bs.x>lv.W*TILE-48)bs.x=lv.W*TILE-48;
  /* bolt hits boss */
  for(var b4=D.bolts.length-1;b4>=0;b4--){
   if(overlap(D.bolts[b4],bs,6,6,30,30)){
    D.bolts.splice(b4,1);bs.hp--;bs.flash=8;SFX.boss();D.shake=5;spawnParts(bs.x+15,bs.y+15,'#ffe066',8);
    if(bs.hp===6||bs.hp===3)lv.berries.push({x:bs.x+8,y:bs.y-20,got:false,cake:true});
    if(bs.hp<=0){bs.dead=true;D.score+=1500;D.shake=14;spawnParts(bs.x+15,bs.y+15,'#5ef2c8',24);D.gateOpen=true;SFX.gate();}
    break;
   }
  }
  if(!bs.dead&&overlap(h,bs,10,18,30,30)){
   if(D.shieldT>0){bs.hp-=2;bs.flash=8;if(bs.hp<=0){bs.dead=true;D.score+=1500;spawnParts(bs.x+15,bs.y+15,'#5ef2c8',24);D.gateOpen=true;SFX.gate();}}
   else heroHit();
  }
 }else if(lv.boss&&lv.boss.dead){D.gateOpen=true;}
 /* gate */
 if(D.gateOpen||!lv.boss){
  if(overlap(h,{x:lv.gate.x-6,y:lv.gate.y-40},10,18,24,320))levelClear();
 }
 /* particles */
 for(var p=D.parts.length-1;p>=0;p--){
  var pt=D.parts[p];pt.x+=pt.vx;pt.y+=pt.vy;pt.vy+=0.2;pt.life--;
  if(pt.life<=0)D.parts.splice(p,1);
 }
 if(D.shake>0)D.shake--;
 /* camera */
 var camT=Math.max(0,Math.min(lv.W*TILE-160,h.x-60+h.vx*8));
 if(Math.abs(camT-D.cam)>160)D.cam=camT;else D.cam+=(camT-D.cam)*0.2;
 D.cam=Math.round(D.cam);
 if(D.t%60===0)saveRun();
 if(D.stats){D.stats.x=h.x;D.stats.charge=Math.round(D.charge);D.stats.score=D.score;}
}
function levelClear(){
 var s=sv();
 if(s.cleared.indexOf(D.idx)<0)s.cleared.push(D.idx);
 if(D.artGot===3&&s.stars.indexOf(D.idx)<0)s.stars.push(D.idx);
 if(D.idx+1>s.unlocked)s.unlocked=Math.min(25,D.idx+1);
 D.bonus=Math.round(D.charge)*10*(D.artGot===3?2:1);
 D.score+=D.bonus;
 if(D.score>s.best)s.best=D.score;
 save(s);
 clearRun();
 SFX.gate();
 if(D.idx===24)recordRun('all periods cleared');
 D.mode='clear';
 render();
}
/* ---------- render ---------- */
var BG={};
function ensureBG(themeKey){
 if(BG[themeKey])return BG[themeKey];
 var t=THEMES[themeKey];
 BG[themeKey]={sky:makeBG(t),far:makeLayer(t,false),near:makeLayer(t,true)};
 return BG[themeKey];
}
function sprite(name,frame){var a=DASHART[name];if(!a)return null;return a.frames[frame%a.frames.length];}
function drawSprite(ctx,name,x,y,frame,flip,scale){
 var s=sprite(name,frame||0);if(!s)return;
 ctx.save();
 if(flip){ctx.translate(x+s.width*scale,y);ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.drawImage(s,0,0,s.width*scale,s.height*scale);}
 else ctx.drawImage(s,x,y,s.width*scale,s.height*scale);
 ctx.restore();
}
function artifactIcon(ctx,key,x,y){
 if(typeof XLICONS!=='undefined'&&XLICONS[key]){ctx.drawImage(XL.iconCanvas?XL.iconCanvas(key):iconCv(key),x,y,16,16);return;}
 var s=sprite(key,0)||sprite('shard',0);if(s)ctx.drawImage(s,x,y,16,16);
}
var ICONCV={};
function iconCv(key){
 if(ICONCV[key])return ICONCV[key];
 var def=XLICONS[key],rows=def.g,w=0,i;
 for(i=0;i<rows.length;i++)w=Math.max(w,rows[i].length);
 var cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=w;cv.height=rows.length;
 var c=cv.getContext('2d');
 for(var y=0;y<rows.length;y++)for(var x=0;x<rows[y].length;x++){var ch=rows[y][x];if(ch==='.'||ch===' ')continue;c.fillStyle=def.c[ch]||'#8df';c.fillRect(x,y,1,1);}
 ICONCV[key]=cv;return cv;
}
function draw(){
 var cv=document.getElementById('dashcv');if(!cv||!D.lv)return;
 var ctx=cv.getContext('2d');ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
 var lv=D.lv,th=THEMES[LEVELS[D.idx].t],bg=ensureBG(LEVELS[D.idx].t);
 var shx=D.shake>0?(Math.random()-0.5)*D.shake:0,shy=D.shake>0?(Math.random()-0.5)*D.shake:0;
 var cy=D.camY||0;
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(Math.round(shx),Math.round(shy));
 ctx.scale(2,2);ctx.translate(0,-cy);
 ctx.drawImage(bg.sky,-((D.cam*0.2)%320),cy);ctx.drawImage(bg.sky,320-((D.cam*0.2)%320),cy);
 var hz=(lv.gt||12)*TILE;
 var fo=(D.cam*0.35)%640,fy=hz-170;ctx.drawImage(bg.far,-fo,fy);ctx.drawImage(bg.far,640-fo,fy);
 var no=(D.cam*0.6)%640,ny=hz-200;ctx.drawImage(bg.near,-no,ny);ctx.drawImage(bg.near,640-no,ny);
 /* ambient motes */
 for(var mi=0;mi<14;mi++){var mr=R(200+mi),mb=mr()*400,mxx=(mb-D.cam*0.8)%180,myy=16+mr()*96,maa=0.18+0.14*Math.sin(D.t*0.05+mi*1.7);if(mxx<0)mxx+=180;ctx.fillStyle=mi%3?'rgba(94,242,200,'+maa+')':'rgba(255,224,102,'+maa+')';ctx.fillRect(mxx-10,myy,2,2);}
 /* tiles */
 var c0=Math.max(0,Math.floor(D.cam/TILE)),c1=Math.min(lv.W-1,c0+21);
 for(var r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(var c=c0;c<=c1;c++){
  var t=lv.tiles[r][c];if(!t)continue;
  var px=c*TILE-D.cam,py=r*TILE;
  if(t===1){
   var topX=(r===0||lv.tiles[r-1][c]===0||lv.tiles[r-1][c]===3);
   ctx.fillStyle=topX?th.gt:th.gf;
   ctx.fillRect(px,py,16,16);
   if(topX){
    ctx.fillStyle=th.ge;ctx.fillRect(px,py,16,2);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,18,48,.35)';ctx.fillRect(px,py+2,16,1);
    var gs=th.gs||'grass';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,18,48,.3)';
    if(gs==='brick'){ctx.fillRect(px,py+7,16,1);ctx.fillRect(px,py+12,16,1);ctx.fillRect(px+((c+r)%2?4:10),py+3,1,4);ctx.fillRect(px+((c+r)%2?11:5),py+8,1,4);ctx.fillRect(px+((c+r)%2?6:12),py+13,1,3);}
    else if(gs==='marble'){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,18,48,.16)';if((c*5+r*3)%3===0){ctx.fillRect(px+2,py+4,9,1);ctx.fillRect(px+10,py+5,1,4);}if((c*3+r*7)%4===0)ctx.fillRect(px+5,py+10,8,1);}
    else if(gs==='cobble'){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,244,255,.15)';ctx.fillRect(px+2+((c*3)%3),py+4,3,2);ctx.fillRect(px+8+((c*5)%3),py+7,3,2);ctx.fillRect(px+4+((c*7)%4),py+11,3,2);}
    else if(gs==='tile'){ctx.fillRect(px,py+8,16,1);ctx.fillRect(px+8,py+3,1,5);ctx.fillRect(px+((c%2)?4:12),py+9,1,7);}
    else if(gs==='plank'){ctx.fillRect(px+5,py+2,1,14);ctx.fillRect(px+11,py+2,1,14);ctx.fillRect(px+3,py+5,1,1);ctx.fillRect(px+13,py+11,1,1);}
    else if(gs==='stone'){ctx.fillRect(px+((c%2)?7:3),py+3,1,13);ctx.fillRect(px,py+9,16,1);}
    else if(gs==='steel'){ctx.fillRect(px,py+8,16,1);ctx.fillStyle=th.ge;ctx.fillRect(px+3,py+5,1,1);ctx.fillRect(px+12,py+5,1,1);ctx.fillRect(px+3,py+12,1,1);ctx.fillRect(px+12,py+12,1,1);}
    else if(gs==='duck'){ctx.fillRect(px,py+5,16,2);ctx.fillRect(px,py+10,16,2);}
    else if(gs==='pave'){ctx.fillRect(px+8,py+3,1,13);if(c%4===0){ctx.fillStyle=th.ge;ctx.fillRect(px+3,py+6,4,1);ctx.fillRect(px+10,py+11,4,1);}}
    else{ctx.fillStyle=th.ge;
     if((c*7+r*13)%3===0)ctx.fillRect(px+1+((c*5)%13),py+4+((c*3)%3),2,1);
     if((c*11+r*7)%4===0)ctx.fillRect(px+2+((c*9)%12),py+8+((r*5)%5),1,1);
     if((c*3+r)%6===0)ctx.fillRect(px+((c*7)%14),py-2,1,2);}
   }else{
    ctx.fillStyle=th.ge;ctx.globalAlpha=0.22;
    if((c*7+r*13)%5===0)ctx.fillRect(px+((c*3)%12),py+((r*5)%12),2,2);
    if((c*5+r*11)%7===0)ctx.fillRect(px+((c*7)%13),py+((r*3)%13),1,1);
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
   }
  }else if(t===2){
   ctx.fillStyle=th.gf;ctx.fillRect(px,py,16,6);
   ctx.fillStyle=th.gt;ctx.fillRect(px,py,16,5);
   ctx.fillStyle=th.ge;ctx.fillRect(px,py,16,2);
   ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,18,48,.4)';ctx.fillRect(px,py+5,16,1);
   ctx.fillStyle=th.ge;ctx.fillRect(px+2,py+3,1,1);ctx.fillRect(px+13,py+3,1,1);
  }else if(t===3){
   var tk=LEVELS[D.idx].t;
   if(tk==='trench'){ctx.strokeStyle=th.ge;ctx.lineWidth=1.4;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px+2,py+4);ctx.lineTo(px+14,py+16);ctx.moveTo(px+14,py+4);ctx.lineTo(px+2,py+16);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px+8,py+2);ctx.lineTo(px+8,py+16);ctx.stroke();}
   else if(tk==='indust'){ctx.fillStyle=th.ge;
    ctx.fillRect(px+1,py+8,6,8);ctx.fillRect(px+9,py+8,6,8);ctx.fillRect(px+5,py+4,6,12);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,18,48,.5)';ctx.fillRect(px+7,py+9,2,3);}
   else{ctx.fillStyle=th.ge;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px,py+16);ctx.lineTo(px+4,py+4);ctx.lineTo(px+8,py+16);ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px+8,py+16);ctx.lineTo(px+12,py+4);ctx.lineTo(px+16,py+16);ctx.fill();}
   ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,18,48,.45)';ctx.fillRect(px,py+14,16,2);
  }
 }
 /* gate */
 var gx=lv.gate.x-D.cam,gy=lv.gate.y;
 var open=D.gateOpen||!lv.boss;
 ctx.strokeStyle=open?'#5ef2c8':'#3a53a0';ctx.lineWidth=3;
 ctx.strokeRect(gx-4,gy-24,24,56);
 if(open){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(94,242,200,'+(0.25+0.15*Math.sin(D.t*0.1))+')';ctx.fillRect(gx-2,gy-22,20,52);}
 /* berries */
 lv.berries.forEach(function(b){
  if(b.got)return;
  var bob=Math.sin((D.t+b.x)*0.08)*2;
  ctx.drawImage(sprite(b.cake?'cake':'berry',0),Math.round(b.x-D.cam-5),Math.round(b.y-5+bob),10,10);
 });
 /* capsules */
 lv.capsules.forEach(function(cp){
  if(cp.open)return;
  var bob=Math.sin((D.t+cp.x)*0.06)*2;
  ctx.drawImage(sprite('capsule',0),Math.round(cp.x-D.cam-6),Math.round(cp.y-6+bob),12,12);
 });
 /* artifacts */
 lv.arts.forEach(function(a){
  if(a.got)return;
  var bob=Math.sin((D.t+a.x)*0.07)*2;
  artifactIcon(ctx,a.k,Math.round(a.x-D.cam-8),Math.round(a.y-8+bob));
 });
 /* enemies */
 D.enemies.forEach(function(e){
  if(e.dead)return;
  var sp=e.kind==='w'?LEVELS[D.idx].w:LEVELS[D.idx].f;
  var fr=Math.floor(D.t/12)%2;
  drawSprite(ctx,sp,Math.round(e.x-D.cam-1),Math.round(e.y-1),fr,e.vx>0,1);
 });
 /* boss */
 var bs=lv.boss;
 if(bs&&!bs.dead){
  var bfr=Math.floor(D.t/14)%2;
  if(bs.flash>0&&Math.floor(D.t/2)%2===0){ctx.globalAlpha=0.5;}
  drawSprite(ctx,bs.kind,Math.round(bs.x-D.cam-1),Math.round(bs.y-2),bfr,bs.dir>0,1);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
 }
 /* bolts */
 D.bolts.forEach(function(b){ctx.drawImage(sprite('bolt',0),Math.round(b.x-D.cam-4),Math.round(b.y-4),8,8);});
 /* hero */
 var h=D.hero,blink=h.iframes>0&&Math.floor(D.t/3)%2===0;
 if(!blink){
  var hfr='hero_run1';
  if(!h.onGround)hfr='hero_jump';
  else if(h.throwT>6)hfr='hero_throw';
  else if(Math.abs(h.vx)>0.2)hfr=Math.floor(h.animT/6)%2===0?'hero_run1':'hero_run2';
  if(D.board){ctx.drawImage(sprite('board',0),Math.round(h.x-D.cam-5),Math.round(h.y+15),20,6);}
  drawSprite(ctx,hfr,Math.round(h.x-D.cam-3),Math.round(h.y-2),0,h.face<0,1);
  var pk=PROP[LEVELS[D.idx].t];
  if(pk){ctx.save();ctx.translate(Math.round(h.x-D.cam+5+h.face*9),Math.round(h.y+8));ctx.scale(h.face*0.75,0.75);artifactIcon(ctx,pk,-8,-8);ctx.restore();}
  if(D.shieldT>0){ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(94,242,200,'+(0.4+0.3*Math.sin(D.t*0.2))+')';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(h.x-D.cam+5,h.y+9,16,0,7);ctx.stroke();}
 }
 /* particles */
 D.parts.forEach(function(p){ctx.fillStyle=p.c;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(p.x-D.cam),Math.round(p.y),2,2);});
 ctx.restore();
 /* era banner at level start */
 if(D.t<160){var ba=D.t<20?D.t/20:(D.t>130?(160-D.t)/30:1);if(ba>0){
  ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,ba);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,18,48,.85)';ctx.fillRect(18,24,284,42);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#5ef2c8';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(19.5,25.5,281,39);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  var t1=AGES[D.idx][0].toUpperCase();
  ctx.font='bold 15px monospace';if(ctx.measureText(t1).width>240)ctx.font='bold 12.5px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8f4ff';ctx.fillText(t1,160,42);
  var t2=range(D.idx)+'  ·  PERIOD '+(D.idx+1)+' / 25';
  ctx.font='10px monospace';if(ctx.measureText(t2).width>250)ctx.font='8.5px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fa4c8';ctx.fillText(t2,160,58);
  ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.globalAlpha=1;}}
 /* HUD */
 ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,18,48,.85)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,320,16);
 ctx.fillStyle='#26366e';ctx.fillRect(4,4,104,8);
 var cf=D.charge/100;
 ctx.fillStyle=D.charge<25?(Math.floor(D.t/8)%2?'#ff5a6e':'#ffe066'):'#5ef2c8';
 ctx.fillRect(5,5,102*cf,6);
 ctx.fillStyle='#e8f4ff';ctx.font='8px monospace';
 ctx.fillText(String(D.score).padStart(7,'0'),116,11);
 for(var hi=0;hi<Math.min(D.lives,7);hi++)ctx.drawImage(sprite('heart',0),196+hi*10,4,8,8);
 var la=LEVELS[D.idx].a;
 for(var ai=0;ai<3;ai++){
  var got=lv.arts[ai].got;
  ctx.globalAlpha=got?1:0.3;
  artifactIcon(ctx,la[ai],234+ai*14,2);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
 }
 ctx.fillStyle='#8fa4c8';ctx.font='8px monospace';
 ctx.fillText((D.idx+1)+'/25',296,11);
 if(D.paused){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,14,39,.7)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,320,240);
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8f4ff';ctx.font='16px monospace';ctx.fillText('PAUSED',132,120);
 }
 if(D.shieldT>0){ctx.fillStyle='#5ef2c8';ctx.fillText('SHIELD',4,26);}
 if(bs&& !bs.dead){
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a1230';ctx.fillRect(90,18,140,8);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff5a6e';ctx.fillRect(91,19,138*(bs.hp/10),6);
 }
}
/* ---------- loop ---------- */
function frame(ts){
 D.frames=(D.frames||0)+1;
 if(D.mode!=='play'||D._notick){D.raf=0;return;}
 D.raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
 if(!D.last)D.last=ts;
 D.acc+=Math.min(100,ts-D.last);D.last=ts;
 while(D.acc>=16.666){D.acc-=16.666;update();}
 draw();
}
/* ---------- module glue ---------- */
function levelListHTML(){
 var s=sv(),out='<div class="worldtimeline">';
 for(var i=0;i<25;i++){
  var locked=i>s.unlocked,star=s.stars.indexOf(i)>=0,cleared=s.cleared.indexOf(i)>=0;
  var bossTag=LEVELS[i].boss?' · Guardian: '+LEVELS[i].bname:'';
  out+='<article class="periodtile"><span class="periodmarker" aria-hidden="true">'+(i+1)+'</span><div><strong>'+esc(AGES[i][0])+'</strong>'
   +'<small>'+esc(range(i))+(star?' · Curator star':'')+(cleared?' · Cleared':'')+esc(bossTag)+'</small>'
   +'<div class="periodactions">'+(locked?'<span class="note">Locked - clear the period before</span>':btn(cleared?'Replay':'Play','XL.dash.intro('+i+')','launch'))+'</div></div></article>';
 }
 return out+'</div>';
}
function cardHTML(title,body,actions){
 return '<section class="erareward"><h2>'+esc(title)+'</h2>'+body+'<div class="chips">'+actions+'</div></section>';
}
var MOD={
 render:function(){
  if(D.mode==='menu'){
   var s=sv();
   return XL.head('Era Rush','Run, jump and throw your way through history - one level per period, oldest to newest.')
    +'<p class="note">Your charge drains as you run: grab zapberries to stay powered. Open time capsules for the spark bolt, the glide board and a shield sprite. Find the 3 lost artifacts in every period for a Curator star. Every fifth period, a Tangle guardian blocks the time gate.</p>'
    +'<p class="note">Best score: <strong>'+s.best+'</strong> · Periods cleared: '+s.cleared.length+'/25 · '+btn(s.muted?'Sound: off':'Sound: on','XL.dash.mute()','launch')+'</p>'+'<p class="note">Keyboard: arrow keys or A/D move, Up/W/Z jump, Space (or X/K) throw. On a phone, use the on-screen buttons.</p><p class="note">Period date ranges are approximate textbook conventions; exact dates vary by region and historian.</p>'
    +(s.run&&s.run.idx>=0&&s.run.idx<25?'<section class="erareward"><h2>Saved run</h2><p>Period '+(s.run.idx+1)+' - '+esc(AGES[s.run.idx][0])+' · score '+esc(String(s.run.score))+' · lives '+esc(String(s.run.lives))+'</p><div class="chips">'+btn('Resume run','XL.dash.resume()','launch')+btn('Discard','XL.dash.discard()','')+'</div><p class="note">Starting any period below begins fresh - best score, stars and cleared periods are kept.</p></section>':'')
    +levelListHTML();
  }
  if(D.mode==='intro'){
   var i=D.idx,body='<p><strong>'+esc(AGES[i][0])+'</strong> - '+esc(range(i))+'</p><p>Lost artifacts to find:</p><p>';
   LEVELS[i].a.forEach(function(k){body+='<span class="note" style="margin-right:8px">'+esc(ANAMES[k]||k)+'</span>';});
   body+='</p>'+(LEVELS[i].boss?'<p>'+esc(LEVELS[i].bname)+' guards the time gate.</p>':'<p>Reach the time gate before your charge runs out.</p>');
   return XL.head('Era Rush','Period '+(i+1)+' of 25')+cardHTML(AGES[i][0],body,btn('Start running','XL.dash.begin()','launch')+btn('All periods','XL.dash.menu()',''));
  }
  if(D.mode==='play'){
   return '<style>.dashback{font-size:11px !important;padding-left:8px !important;padding-right:8px !important}header.top:has(>.dashback){grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) !important}</style><header class="top">'+btn('\u25c0 Games','XL.close()','navbtn dashback')+'<span class="navbtn" style="cursor:default;flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px">'+esc(AGES[D.idx][0])+'</span></header>'
    +'<style>.dashwrap,.dashwrap *{-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}'
    +'.erbtn{border:2px solid #26366e;border-radius:14px;background:#141f4a;color:#e8f4ff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;line-height:1.1;font-family:inherit;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;touch-action:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0}'
    +'.erbtn .erico{font-size:24px;line-height:1}'
    +'.erbtn.on{transform:scale(.93);filter:brightness(1.35)}'
    +'</style>'
    +'<div class="dashwrap" style="touch-action:none" oncontextmenu="return false"><canvas id="dashcv" width="320" height="240" style="width:100%;image-rendering:pixelated;border:2px solid #26366e;border-radius:12px;background:#0a1230"></canvas>'
    +'<p class="note" style="margin:6px 2px 0;font-size:11px;text-align:center">Drag left or right on the game to run</p>'
    +'<div class="dashpad" style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:8px">'
    +'<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;width:100%">'
    +'<button id="padT" class="erbtn" style="flex:1;height:66px;background:#33290c;border-color:#ffe066;color:#ffe066"><span class="erico">&#8623;</span><span>THROW</span></button>'
    +'<button id="padJ" class="erbtn" style="flex:1.2;height:66px;background:#0d3325;border-color:#5ef2c8;color:#5ef2c8"><span class="erico">&#9650;</span><span>JUMP</span></button>'
    +'</div></div></div>';
  }
  if(D.mode==='clear'){
   var more=D.idx<24;
   var body='<p>'+esc(AGES[D.idx][0])+' cleared! Artifacts found: <strong>'+D.artGot+'/3</strong>'+(D.artGot===3?' - Curator star!':'')
    +'<br>Charge bonus: +'+D.bonus+'<br>Score: <strong>'+D.score+'</strong> (best '+sv().best+')</p>';
   return XL.head('Era Rush','Period cleared')+cardHTML('Through the gate!',body,(more?btn('Next period','XL.dash.intro('+(D.idx+1)+',1)','launch'):'')+btn('All periods','XL.dash.menu()',''));
  }
  if(D.mode==='gameover'){
   return XL.head('Era Rush','Out of time')
    +cardHTML('Out of time','<p>The trail goes cold... for now. Score: <strong>'+D.score+'</strong></p>',btn('Try again','XL.dash.intro('+D.idx+')','launch')+btn('All periods','XL.dash.menu()',''));
  }
  return '';
 },
 after:function(){
  if(D.mode==='play'){
   padBtn('padJ','jump');padBtn('padT','throwB');bindDrag();
   D.last=0;D.acc=0;
   if(!D.raf)D.raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
 }
};
XL.reg('dash',MOD);
XL.dash={
 intro:function(i,carry){D.idx=i;D.carry=!!carry;D.mode='intro';render();},
 begin:function(){startLevel(D.idx);if(!D.carry){D.score=0;D.runStart=D.idx;D.recorded=false;}D.lives=3;D.mode='play';render();},
 menu:function(){if(D.mode==='play')saveRun();D.mode='menu';render();},
 mute:function(){var s=sv();s.muted=!s.muted;save(s);render();},
 resume:function(){if(!restoreRun()){D.mode='menu';render();}},
 discard:function(){clearRun();render();},
 state:function(){var ne=nearestEnemy();return {frames:D.frames||0,mode:D.mode,idx:D.idx,hasBolt:D.hasBolt,board:D.board,enx:ne?Math.round(ne.x):null,eny:ne?Math.round(ne.y):null,enk:ne?ne.kind:null,x:D.hero?Math.round(D.hero.x):0,y:D.hero?Math.round(D.hero.y):0,vx:D.hero?+D.hero.vx.toFixed(2):0,vy:D.hero?+D.hero.vy.toFixed(2):0,og:D.hero?D.hero.onGround:null,charge:Math.round(D.charge),score:D.score,lives:D.lives,artGot:D.artGot,enemies:D.enemies?D.enemies.filter(function(e){return !e.dead}).length:0,deaths:D.deaths||[],boss:D.lv&&D.lv.boss?{hp:D.lv.boss.hp,dead:!!D.lv.boss.dead,x:Math.round(D.lv.boss.x)}:null,gateOpen:!!D.gateOpen};},
 test:function(i,auto,lives){D._notick=true;if(D.raf){cancelAnimationFrame(D.raf);D.raf=0;}D.idx=i;startLevel(i);D.lives=(lives===undefined?99:lives);D.score=0;D.mode='play';D.auto=!!auto;D.stats={};D.deaths=[];render();},
 step:function(n){for(var i=0;i<n;i++){if(D.mode==='play')update();}draw();},
 warp:function(x){if(D.hero){var col=Math.floor(x/TILE),gy=0;while(gy<ROWS&&!solidAt(D.lv,col,gy))gy++;D.hero.x=x;D.hero.y=(gy-3)*TILE;D.hero.vy=0;D.hero.iframes=120;}},
 rec:function(n,x0,x1){var out=[];for(var i=0;i<n;i++){if(D.mode==='play')update();var h=D.hero;if(h&&h.x>=x0&&h.x<=x1)out.push([D.t,Math.round(h.x),Math.round(h.y),+h.vx.toFixed(1),+h.vy.toFixed(1),h.onGround?1:0,h.coyote,h.buffer,IN.jump?1:0,IN.jumpHeld?1:0]);}draw();return out;},
 dbg:function(c0,c1){var lv=D.lv,rows=[];c0=c0||0;c1=c1||40;for(var r=6;r<ROWS;r++){var line='';for(var c=c0;c<c1;c++){var t=lv.tiles[r][c];line+=t===0?'.':t===1?'#':t===2?'=':t===3?'^':'?';}rows.push(line);}return {probe:[[10,13],[10,14],[10,15],[11,13],[11,14],[11,15],[12,14]].map(function(p){return lv.tiles[p[0]][p[1]]}),rows:rows,spawns:lv.spawns.slice(0,6),caps:lv.capsules.map(function(c){return [c.x,c.gives]}),arts:lv.arts.map(function(a){return [a.x,a.y]}),gate:lv.gate?lv.gate.x:null,gt:lv.gt,W:lv.W,ROWS:ROWS};}
};
})();
/* ---------- home games accordion entry ---------- */
(function(){
 function addTile(){
  var opens=document.querySelectorAll('.duopen');
  for(var i=0;i<opens.length;i++){var o=opens[i];
   if(o.querySelector('[data-er-tile]'))continue;
   if(!/Anachronist/.test(o.textContent))continue;
   var b=document.createElement('button');
   b.className='tile launch';b.setAttribute('data-er-tile','1');
   b.innerHTML='<strong>Era Rush</strong><small>Run, jump and throw through all 25 periods.</small>';
   b.addEventListener('click',function(){XL.open('dash');});
   var notes=o.querySelectorAll('p.note');
   var last=notes.length?notes[notes.length-1]:null;
   if(last&&last.parentNode===o)o.insertBefore(b,last);else o.appendChild(b);
  }
 }
 var rn=window.render;
 if(typeof rn==='function'){window.render=function(){var r=rn.apply(this,arguments);try{addTile();}catch(e){}return r;};}
 setTimeout(addTile,800);setTimeout(addTile,2500);
})();

</script>
</body></html>
